user.title: Connect to Incus
user.description: Place a trusted client certificate and private key in the Home Assistant configuration directory. Enter their file paths. For self-signed Incus servers, supply the server certificate as the CA file (recommended). Project * discovers all accessible projects.

data.ca_path: Server CA or certificate file path (optional)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the Incus API. Check the address, project, and network.
error.invalid_certificate: Cannot load the client certificate or key. Check the file paths and permissions.
error.invalid_server_certificate: Cannot verify the Incus server certificate. Supply it as a CA file.
error.invalid_auth: The client certificate is not trusted or cannot list instances.

abort.already_configured: This Incus host and project are already configured.
